items.title: Frank Chace Interview, 1961-11-18
items.q: I don't hear any talk about Matlock among different clarinet players. He's, of course, he's now one of the chieftains of the L.A. School of Playing, and everybody admires his work, but in connection with Chicago or the Bobcats, I don't hear anything.

ctx.x: Who are we talking about on all the West Coast records? The clarinet player who does so much arraignment? Matlock.
Well, Matlock, on the other hand, he was playing for several years in Chicago with the Bobcats, and everybody got to know him. Now, do you feel that he might have left an influence?
